top_choice_rationale: P001 recognizes a mature physiological discovery with exceptional, durable therapeutic benefit in diabetes and obesity. A GLP-1-physiology-centered citation gives Holst, Mojsov, and Drucker a coherent allocation while avoiding attribution of the entire later drug-development enterprise to them.
recusal_note: No candidate-specific conflict is apparent from the supplied profile. Its documented collaborations concern Ronald Evans, Johan Ericson, and committee members rather than any proposed laureate.
